items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks 'you going to mention Helen?' and 'Should we?' but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not respond to this prompt or mention Helen in the provided transcript context.

ctx.x: Well, yes, I am. I think what I'm doing, too, yes I am, Stanley. I think what I'm doing, too, there might be -- yes, these are right in those years. You're quite right about too that and the thing that happened too -- you going to mention Helen?
